description.zh:
播流域名。
- 支持单个或批量域名查询。批量查询时多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。
- 若参数为空，默认返回所有直播域名合并后的数据。
description.en:
The streaming domain.
- You can specify a single domain name or multiple domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).
- If this parameter is not specified, the merged data of all live streaming domain names is returned by default.

description.zh: 结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 结束时间需大于起始时间。起止时间和结束时间，间隔不超过一年。
description.en: The end time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). The end time must be later than the start time. The interval between the start time and end time cannot exceed one year.

description.zh:
查询数据的时间粒度。单位：秒（s）。取值：

- **300**。
- **3600**。
- **86400**。

不传或传的值不支持，且时间跨度不超过3天时，默认值300秒。超过3天默认值3600秒。超过30天默认值86400秒。
description.en:
The time granularity of the queried data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

- **300**
- **3600**
- **86400**

If this parameter is not specified or the specified value is not supported, the default value is 300 seconds when the time span does not exceed 3 days, 3600 seconds when the time span exceeds 3 days, and 86400 seconds when the time span exceeds 30 days.

description.zh: 实时日志投递的Logstore。若参数为空，默认返回所有Logstore合并后数据。
description.en: The Logstore for real-time log delivery. If this parameter is not specified, the merged data of all Logstores is returned by default.

description.zh: 实时日志投递的Project。若参数为空，默认返回所有Project合并后数据。
description.en: The Project for real-time log delivery. If this parameter is not specified, the merged data of all Projects is returned by default.
The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

title.zh: 查询实时日志投递次数

descriptions.zh:
- 可以统计实时日志投递次数信息。统计实时日志投递失败次数和实时日志投递成功次数。
- 支持UID维度查询。
- 收费次数包含投递成功和失败的全部次数。


## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- Queries statistics on real-time log delivery attempts, including the number of successful and failed log delivery attempts.
- Supports queries by UID dimension.
- The billable count includes both successful and failed log delivery attempts.


## QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this API is 100 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, the API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Invoke this API appropriately.

example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveRealtimeDeliveryAcc --region cn-hangzhou --Project project_example --EndTime '2015-12-10T21:05:00Z' --LogStore logstore_example --DomainName 'example.com' --StartTime '2015-12-10T20:00:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Interval 3600
